about.p1: Set among the unspoilt nature of Assos in Büyükhusun village, our 28-room hotel welcomes guests with bed-and-breakfast and half-board options. The warmth of traditional stone architecture meets a modern sense of comfort.
about.p2: Just 5 km from Kadırga Bay and minutes from ancient Assos, the hotel is an ideal base for those who want to experience the sea, history and nature all in one holiday.

story.p1: Assos Karadut Taş Otel rises in the quiet beauty of Büyükhusun village, in a unique setting that opens onto the blue of the Aegean. With 28 rooms and both bed-and-breakfast and half-board options, we blend traditional stone architecture with a modern sense of comfort.
story.p2: Just 5 km from Kadırga Bay and minutes from ancient Assos and Assos Harbour, our hotel is tailor-made for those who wish to bring together the Aegean's history, nature and sea in a single holiday.
story.p3Suffix: on TripAdvisor is the finest reflection of the service and the setting we offer.
story.seasonalText: We are open from April to October.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.desc: To make guests feel the warmth of home away from home, and to help them experience the nature of the Aegean and the history of Assos to the fullest.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.desc: To be the finest boutique hotel in the Assos region and to lead sustainable tourism by keeping traditional stone architecture alive.

certified.title: Ministry of Culture Certified
certified.desc: We are a licensed accommodation certified by the Turkish Ministry of Culture and Tourism (Licence No: 24921).

features.p1: Our sea-view outdoor pool and separate children's pool welcome every age group. The poolside bar keeps you refreshed while adding to the pleasure.
features.p2: Our à la carte restaurant serves Aegean flavours prepared with fresh local ingredients, along with made-to-order breakfast (08:30–10:30).

reviews.title: What Our Guests Say
reviews.review1: We absolutely loved this place. We stayed two nights and are checking out today, and I'm genuinely sad to leave. Finding such a beautiful view and such a peaceful spot to spend two days was an incredible experience. We stayed in the one-bedroom suites; the fine decorative touches in the rooms and the magnificent view towards Lesbos were simply lovely. There was even a fireplace, but our view was so beautiful that we spent all our time on the balcony. The owners have thought of every detail — it feels less like a hotel and more as if they designed their own home. Breakfast was ample and delicious. The hotel's mascots, Ares and Tarçın, are affectionate, well-trained dogs, and we had a wonderful time with them too. Peerless views, wonderful peace — highly recommended.
reviews.review2: As a family, our two-night stay in the one-bedroom suites at Karadut Taş Otel exceeded our expectations. Attentive, friendly staff, clean and comfortable rooms, a magnificent view and quiet, a superb location to unwind — it truly deserves its five stars. Although the hotel is 7–8 minutes from the coast, the free access to the beach at their own guesthouse in Kadırga Bay is fantastic. In short, I felt proud to have a place like this; from now on I'd love to spend a few days here every year to recharge. My thanks to everyone involved.
reviews.review3: Karadut Otel was our accommodation of choice during our Assos holiday. It's a lovely family-run business. Yağız and his family are both very warm and very professional; they met all our needs with patience. The rooms are clean and airy, and the distance between the apartments gives enough privacy. We loved the infinity pool too; it has a perfect view. There is also a children's pool, and the pool was spotless and well kept. When we booked by phone we got a much better rate than online — I'd suggest reaching them via their contact number.

team.p1: At Assos Karadut Taş Otel, our approach to service goes beyond corporate coolness. The owners and their team look after every guest personally, anticipating their needs in advance.
team.p2: Our team knows the region well and is glad to share the hidden coves around Assos, the walking trails, and the restaurants serving the freshest seafood.

intro.title: Comfort Set in Stone
intro.text: Our hotel offers 3 room types, and every room is equipped with air conditioning, TV, Wi-Fi, a minibar, a wardrobe and a private bathroom. With our sea-view options, take in the Aegean right from your room.

deluxe.desc: Wake to a sea view each morning through windows that open onto the magnificent blue of the Aegean. Designed with modern comfort across 24 m², with air conditioning for a comfortable stay in every season.

traditional.desc: This 22 m² room offers a partial Aegean view along with all standard comforts. With air conditioning, TV and minibar, it is the ideal choice for guests seeking a relaxed stay.

family.desc: At 44 m², this is our largest room. Designed for a spacious, relaxed holiday with your family, it accommodates up to 4 guests. With a separate sitting area and an outdoor dining table, it offers the full comfort of a family holiday.
